notes.title: Metaneurosis Roadmap + Demo Changes!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]I wanted to share a quick update on where things are headed. I’ve put together a visual [b]roadmap[/b] outlining what’s coming next for [i]Metaneurosis[/i], from new world content to upcoming polish and side quests.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473911/c29ced27396d0aa96c02a550ba4d374bf1866e56.png"][/img][/p][p]Demo Update:[/p][p]The demo has been updated to include all the new changes made to the game's mechanics. It now has all the same features and QoL improvements as the main game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank You:[/b][/p][p]Seriously, thanks so much to everyone who has played, left feedback, or even just wishlisted the game. This project means a lot to me, and your support is what helps keep it moving forward.[/p][p]As always, feel free to drop thoughts, theories, or just weird observations in the discussions — especially with how much bizarre stuff there is in this game.[/p][p]More soon![/p][p]— Lazy Dev Studio[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473911/8a60dd21ff0280a94754a8fcf41014bab519dc51.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Minor QoL adjustments
notes.notes: [p]This small patch focuses on visual clarity and usability improvements throughout the game, along with a few new polish touches:[/p][p]🔧 [b]Fixes & Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed incorrect world naming and added proper world name display to the pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted bottom-left menu colors for better readability.[/p][/*][*][p]Location names now appear on quest entries for easier tracking.[/p][/*][*][p]Unit shop now uses paging to reduce scroll fatigue and improve load performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded the character compendium with new entries.[/p][/*][/list][p]Just a little housekeeping before the next big update![/p]

notes.title: Of Popcorn and Politics: The Great Goblins Plot
notes.notes:
[p]Goblins, greed, and some deeply questionable food science — the Goblins World is now a fully realized realm, complete with a full story arc, new maps, chaotic new units, and a witch who may or may not have committed popcorn-based war crimes.
                                                        [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473911/d573d4b205bfe524b52b1763432bb1fd4d65bebb.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]🌲 [b]New Locations[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Snilbog[/b] – Home to the forest goblins. Beware their politics.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Goblin Forest[/b] – A sacred grove providing life and protection to all goblins.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gobver[/b] – A bustling river town full of stingy merchant goblins.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Witch House[/b] – The goblins claim she’s behind all their problems... but is she?[/p][/*][*][p][b]Troll Cave[/b] – Is he the nasty kind of troll, or just a misunderstood memer?[/p][/*][/list][p]All this can be accessed from a mysterious portal inside a restaurant in Neural Haven.[/p][p][/p][p]⚔️ [b]Some[/b] [b]New Units to Recruit or Avoid[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Forest Goblin Archer[/b] – Fragile, but dangerous at range.[/p][/*][*][p][b]River Goblin Shaman[/b] – Summons sea creatures to do the dirty work.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Witch’s Daughters[/b] – Like kids, but with claws. And zero mercy. Also catlike reflexes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Giant Mushroom[/b] – You might be hallucinating, but it’s definitely trying to kill you.[/p][/*][/list][p]Try out the new world to see the whole host of other new units.[/p][p]                                                          [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473911/3db87574c28b570dcd137c937729df02ebab2567.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]📖 [b]A Tale of Entitlement, Isolation, and Inheritance Gone Wrong[/b][/p][p]The goblins believe the witch owes them everything. After all, she’s old, reclusive, and sitting on a stockpile of enchanted food. But the truth is far more bitter — and the world she's built may just reflect a real person long forgotten.
Also, her daughters might be monsters. But they might also be... just a little misunderstood.[/p][p][/p][p]New features:[/p][list][*][p][b]Story Mode[/b] – Enable an auto-win button in combat (via Game Options) for players who want to focus purely on the story.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Combat Tutorial Prompt[/b] – Your first battle now offers a prompt to view the tutorial. You can permanently disable it.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Notable fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Visual consistency improved across some areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where NPCs could track and re-initiate combat if you opened the menu after fleeing.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Plunder and Wonder — The Pirates World Sets Sail!
notes.notes:
Ahoy, travelers! The Pirates World is no longer just a whisper on the waves — it's now a fully explorable, content-rich region with a complete story quest line, new islands, wild new units, and some deeply questionable seafood philosophy.

🗺️ New Locations Added:
[list]
[*]Crabylon – Where man and crab have united... somehow.
[*]The Isle of Wipe – A once-proud sponge civilization reduced to one grimy survivor.
[*]Sunken Cavern – An eerie underwater passage full of secrets.
[*] Ship Fortress – Board the most heavily defended (and over-compensated) vessel on the sea.
[/list]
*All of these locations are accessible from the private door inside the coffee shop — if you know, you know.


⚔️ New Units to Recruit or Face:
[list]
[*] Mast Sniper – Because height advantage is everything.
[*] Sponge – Surprisingly absorbent. Emotionally and otherwise.
[*] Sharkataur – Half-shark, half-beast, all bad attitude.
[*] Kraken – Tentacles. So many tentacles.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473911/2bb4d342f545a1acb7522df6e5de3b80a407e56e.gif[/img]

 New Spell:

 Crablightenment – Achieve inner peace. And outer pincers.

📖 A Tale of Salt, Regret, and Rope-Bound Madness

The pirate lords Woodbeard and Kraktacle will stop at nothing to hold their grip on the sea — but they aren't your only concern.
Someone from your past awaits: Ivana, a ghost from your childhood, lost in a storm of memory and trauma.
This journey isn't just about treasure... it's about confronting what you've buried.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473911/be20987b4531fd623b32279170a207116d95da95.gif[/img]

Notable Fixes:
[list]
[*] Default action key is now [E] for a more familiar control scheme.
[*] Interaction bubble now includes an indicator to make talking, looting, and activating things more intuitive.
[/list]

🛠️ Next Up: Goblins World

The next update will focus on finishing the Goblins World, accessible from the kitchen in the southernmost restaurant in Neural Haven. Expect strange mushrooms, a recluse witch, and goblins with questionable business ethics.
